evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth: 2.90→3.01→3.07→3.15→3.22 Torr, versus a stable ~2.94 Torr during ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Temperature holding at setpoint 750 °C with normal heater power ~46%
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere integrity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up/valve-response test) would distinguish an air leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; without the O2 channel the cause cannot be pinned down.
